sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

Semantic validator feedback: Replace the two generated shape IRIs nltl:GeneratedShape_I2_032 and nltl:GeneratedShape_I2_032_HullAreaValue with blank-node shapes or non-vocabulary shape IRIs; they are unknown canonical terms and make deterministicValidation.valid false. Then repair the formula coverage: every declared operand must be explicitly usable in the calculation. In particular, span is constrained but never bound or used, and hullAreaFactor is placed on an unlinked hullAreaValue node, so the ship-targeted calculation cannot access it. Either provide the canonical cross-owner path and bind/use hullAreaFactor, or remove that operand only if the verified contract is corrected; do not leave an inaccessible standalone shape. Preserve the >= comparison and tolerance-based derived-result check.

Repair the calculation and owner/path structure before freezing. Move peakPressureFactor to the supplied canonical owner ship; it is incorrectly constrained on structuralMember. Bind and use every declared operand: span is currently unused, and hullAreaFactor is neither linked from the ship nor used—the tautological FILTER (?hullAf = ?hullAf) is not coverage. Locate and use the canonical cross-owner path from the ship to hullAreaValue/hullAreaFactor; do not invent a path or target benchmarkEntity. Use the correct AF operand consistently, preserve LL as the lesser of frame span a and load-patch height b, and compare A_w and A_t in compatible units (the candidate compares m² shearArea with cm² required area without conversion). Retain the >= violation logic and tolerance scaled from the expected calculated result. The previously reported generated-shape unknown-IRI problem is resolved by the gen: shape IRIs.

Do not freeze. Preserve the prior repairs: peakPressureFactor is correctly owned by the ship, but the calculation remains incomplete and has wrong ownership/path coverage. Constrain hasStructuralMember with the required relationship/cardinality and ensure its structural-member node supplies frameSpacing, selectedHullAreaFactor, and requiredTransverseFrameShearArea. The declared operand span is still omitted entirely; add the canonical ship-owned span property, bind it, and use it in the verified LL calculation alongside the required frame-span and load-patch-height operands. hullAreaFactor is not structurally constrained or reachable: nltl:hasComponent points to shipComponent and is an invalid/invented route to the hullAreaValue owner. Remove that needless indirection and locate/use the canonical ship-to-hullAreaValue path; this missing canonical cross-owner path requires matcher resolution. Ensure the hull-area factor is bound and used consistently with selectedHullAreaFactor. Finally, the query compares shearArea in m² directly with requiredTransverseFrameShearArea in cm²; convert A_w to cm² (or otherwise normalize both values) before enforcing A_w >= A_t. Retain the lesser-of-span/height calculation and tolerance-scaled derived-result check, with every declared operand explicitly constrained, reachable, bound, and used.
